The Buddhist monks, the tonsured, those who wear white apparels, those who beg wearing good robes, those who wear blood-red clothes and those that have conquered their Jive senses-all these mendicants are ruled by Mars. आजोीविनां कुहकिनां समयाधिकारे ये दीक्षितास्तनुभृतः खलु गारुडे च। wa वशूरपिशितशनयोऽच युक्ता- स्तेषां श्चा ङ्ुतनयोऽधिपतिनि रुदतः ॥३३॥ 33. Mercury denotes an alm-seeker, a conjurer, a snake poison curer, and one who eats the flesh of a peacock. Notes: The words “मयूरविशिताशन” are split thus: मयूर 6800०1६, पिशित flesh, श्राशन-- eat.
